title: Clean cook cafeteria Linux package with Vulkan SM6 hardware RT
objective: Run the long-running clean Linux cook/package needed to apply the approved Vulkan SM6 hardware ray tracing config to the cafeteria SPEAR package, then verify the produced artifacts/logs show VULKAN_SM6 instead of VULKAN_SM5. This is the validation step for the user's requested hardware RT path.
instructions: Use /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4 as the Unreal engine directory.

Run a clean cook/stage/package/archive/pak for /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark. Suggested command: python tools/run_uat.py --unreal-engine-dir /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4 --clean-archive-dir --cook-maps /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark -clean -cook -stage -package -archive -pak -skipbuild
Activate the project conda environment if needed, matching prior cook workflows: source /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate spear-env.
Capture logs under .control-tower/runs with a clear timestamped run directory if tools/run_uat.py does not already do so.

After cook/package, verify logs and the staged pak/listing for VULKAN_SM6. Positive signatures: VULKAN_SM6 shader autogen or GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM6.bin. Negative signatures: only VULKAN_SM5, GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM5.bin only, or shader platform still SM5.

If practical in the current environment, also run a short startup/live validation with VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json python examples/flashlight/run.py --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --live-lighting-mode realistic --flashlight-profile realistic_live_flashlight --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0005 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --startup-warmup-seconds 3 and check for Platform=VULKAN_SM6, ray tracing enabled dynamically, ray tracing shaders enabled, and hardware RT readback confirmed=true. If display/runtime validation is not possible, report why and provide the exact command/signatures for the user.
constraints: Do not modify product code or Git state.

artifacts: Inspector approved the Linux Vulkan SM6 hardware RT config change in cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Config/DefaultEngine.ini: project LinuxTargetSettings now removes SF_VULKAN_SM5, adds SF_VULKAN_SM6, and sets bEnableRayTracing=True; clean cook/package validation is still required.

expected_outputs: Cook/package command, run directory, exit status, and key log excerpts/signatures.
Whether VULKAN_SM6 artifacts were produced and whether VULKAN_SM5-only artifacts remain.
If runtime validation was attempted, the runtime RT log verdict; if not, the exact user test command.
definition_of_done: Cafeteria Linux package is recooked/staged/package with VULKAN_SM6 artifacts verified, or a concrete blocker is reported with logs.
